name: RepliBench
description: RepliBench is a suite of evaluations designed to measure the autonomous replication capabilities of language model agents across four core domains, consisting of 20 task families and 86 individual tasks.
reputation: A very recent and specialized benchmark with limited public adoption so far, aimed at studying autonomous replication behavior in agents.
notes: Evaluates safety risks related to uncontrollable autonomous replication of language model agents; includes novel task families and benchmarks frontier models.
